protocol.comparison_policy: Raw main34 and no-Taipei33; three clustering mechanisms, raw/embedding controls, fixed representatives, projection parameter/seed and special-region sensitivity
protocol.distance_policy: Each representation divided by own positive pairwise median. Matrix rows never used as features. CH/DB only on actual Euclidean embedding features.
protocol.dbscan_policy: epsilon from 3rd-other-neighbor distances (min_samples=4 includes self); quantiles 0.1/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.9. At median epsilon also compare min_samples3/4/5. Degenerate partitions retained with unavailable metrics.
protocol.noise_policy: silhouette/CH/DB exclude noise; report coverage. ARI/NMI all-node comparison treats noise as a label and also reports non-noise intersection with trivial-partition flags.
protocol.representative_policy: k=4, PAM seed42, DBSCAN median epsilon/min_samples4 fixed before scores; no automatic winner selection
